name: [Mutations ☢️] Lucky Fishings!
desc:
Welcome to Lucky Fishings! 🎣

Cast your line, catch rare fish, and unlock epic rods!

1. Charge your cast and throw your bait into the water! 🌊
2. Click to reel in your catch! 🐟
3. Place fish on pads to earn cash! 💰

Watch out for the Kraken! 🐙

If you're having fun, hit the thumbs up! 👍
